topic: What antenna designs balance aerodynamic constraints with MIMO requirements for high-speed aircraft communication?
consensus_response: Conformal phased arrays and compact antennas minimize drag while supporting MIMO. AI-enhanced beamforming optimizes link quality, and reconfigurable antennas adapt to changing conditions. Metamaterials improve electromagnetic properties, enabling efficient designs. Phased array calibration ensures accurate beam patterns, maximizing channel capacity.
reference_context: Antenna design must consider mission constraints, space environment, and cost for inter-satellite communications and aeronautical ad-hoc networks.
